segments.thag2.12:1.1: “Ye kho te veṭhamissena [veghamissena (sī. syā.), ve gamissena, vekhamissena (ka.)], nānattena ca kammunā;
segments.thag2.12:1.5: Tepi tattheva kīranti, na hi kammaṃ panassati.
segments.thag2.12:2.1: “Yaṃ karoti naro kammaṃ, kalyāṇaṃ yadi pāpakaṃ;
segments.thag2.12:2.3: Tassa tasseva dāyādo, yaṃ yaṃ kammaṃ pakubbatī”ti.
